name: TMK
recent: TMK Chemical 正在推进以 RM939.9 million 收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 100% 股权的提案，其中约 RM438.5 million 以现金支付，其余通过发行 262,500,000 股新股支付。公司已向 Bursa Securities 申请延长提交附加上市申请和股东通函的期限。此外，公司宣布了每股 3.6 仙的中期股息，并有一项关联方交易的实际值超出预估 10% 以上。
notable: 拟以 RM939.9 million 收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad 100% 股权，其中约 RM438.5 million 以现金支付，其余通过发行 262,500,000 股新股支付。
宣布每股 3.6 仙的中期单层股息。
向 Bursa Securities 申请延长提交与收购提案相关的附加上市申请和股东通函的期限。
risks: 拟议收购涉及发行 262,500,000 股新股，可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
BKB 作为卖方之一，将寻求证券委员会批准豁免其及一致行动人因收购完成而需对 TMK 剩余股份提出强制性全面收购的义务。
一项关联方交易的实际值超出 2026 年 4 月 28 日通函中披露的预估值的 10% 以上。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度，营收为 RM310.4 million，环比增长 28.6%，同比增长 17.7%；净收入为 RM40.8 million，环比增长 35.4%，同比增长 91.5%；净利率为 13.1%，高于上一季度的 12.5%。

recent_en: TMK Chemical is proceeding with its proposed acquisition of 100% of Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) for RM939.9 million, to be satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million in cash and the issuance of 262,500,000 new shares. The company has applied to Bursa Securities for an extension of time to submit the additional listing application and circular to shareholders. Separately, it declared an interim dividend of 3.6 sen per share, and a recurrent related party transaction's actual value exceeded the estimated value by more than 10%.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% of Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad for RM939.9 million, to be satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million in cash and the issuance of 262,500,000 new shares.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 3.6 sen per share.
Applied to Bursa Securities for an extension of time to submit the additional listing application and circular to shareholders in relation to the acquisition proposal.
risks_en: The proposed acquisition involves the issuance of 262,500,000 new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.

BKB, one of the vendors, will seek an exemption from the Securities Commission Malaysia from the obligation to undertake a mandatory take-over offer for the remaining TMK shares upon completion of the acquisition.
The actual value of a recurrent related party transaction exceeded the estimated value disclosed in the circular dated 28 April 2026 by more than 10%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM310.4 million, up 28.6% QoQ and 17.7% YoY; net income was RM40.8 million, up 35.4% QoQ and 91.5% YoY; net margin was 13.1%, compared with 12.5% in the previous quarter.
